prompts.background: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished 16-bit pixel-art RPG battlefield background for Chaos Gate, wide 16:9 landscape, no characters, no UI, no text. A spectacular dark chaotic realm: fractured black basalt arena floating over an abyss, crimson-magenta rifts and molten golden lightning in a storming dark sky, distant broken gothic pillars and floating shards. Clear readable dark slate combat platform occupies bottom 42% with an unobstructed flat walkable surface, horizon at 58%, perspective suitable for side-view RPG combat. Far background dramatic but darker than foreground character sprites. Deliberately crisp visible pixel clusters, limited palette, no painterly smooth gradients. Distinct red, ember-gold, and deep burgundy palette. One complete background image, no doors or foreground gate, no creatures, no words, no watermark.
prompts.gate: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG game sprite, a single closed Chaos Gate for a 16-bit pixel-art RPG. Front-facing symmetric monumental double door made of black obsidian, jagged gothic pointed arch, five sharp hornlike stone spires, glowing scarlet and ember-gold runic inlays, crimson crystals embedded in the frame. The two CLOSED opaque dark metal door leaves meet precisely at the vertical center seam x=50%, to be split in half and animated sideways by the game. One solid closed gate, not an open portal. Full object including both feet, no cropping, keep 8% transparent padding top and bottom and 15% left and right. The gate occupies ~70% canvas width and 88% height, on square canvas, upright centered. Sharp visible pixel clusters, restrained highlights, dark readable silhouette, no painted soft edges. Everything outside the gate fully transparent, including gaps between the spires. No ground, shadow, scenery, characters, text, labels, watermark or sprite sheet.
